name: down_quark

phase_0.boundary_condition: The color-singlet confinement boundary — a topological enclosure where SU(3) color flux tubes bind quarks into hadrons, preventing free color charge propagation beyond ~1 fm.

⊢.justification: The unexcited QCD vacuum before any quark flavor or color degree of freedom is instantiated — the void state from which down quark excitations emerge.

⊣.justification: The closed topological boundary of a hadron where net color charge vanishes; the terminal anchor that contains the quark system and defines its observable existence.

≻.justification: Forward morphism representing quark field evolution — emission of a gluon, flavor-preserving strong interaction vertex, or spatial propagation within the hadronic bag.

≺.justification: Contravariant reversal mapping quark to anti-quark — charge conjugation that flips color triplet to anti-triplet, electric charge sign, and baryon number, representing the descent transformation.

⋈.justification: Sequential composition of quark-gluon vertices building the hadronic bound state — the chaining of color exchanges that constructs proton (uud) or neutron (udd) from constituent quarks.

⊙.justification: Self-reference of the down quark — its immutable flavor quantum number (generation 1, charge -1/3), color representation (triplet), and baryon number (1/3) that persist through all interactions.

∈.justification: The fundamental fork separating left-handed (SU(2)_L doublet) and right-handed (SU(2)_R singlet) chiral components — the electroweak symmetry breaking that gives distinct gauge interactions to each chirality.

∋.justification: Rejoining of chiral arms into a massive Dirac fermion within the hadron — the chiral symmetry breaking condensate ⟨q̄q⟩ that fuses left and right components, reconstituting the confined quark with dynamical mass.

⊤.justification: Affirmative arm: color-singlet hadron formed, quark confined, asymptotic freedom satisfied — the constructive truth of QCD confinement.

⊥.justification: Negative arm: free quark state, color flux tube broken, string tension overcome — the constructive falsity of deconfinement (not observed at low energy).

⊞.justification: The B-state holding both chiralities simultaneously — the massive quark as a superposition of left and right components, neither pure, both required for the physical particle; a live contradiction resolved by the Higgs mechanism.

⊡.justification: Irreversible fixation: a deep inelastic scattering event or hadron decay measurement that permanently records the quark's momentum fraction, flavor, and spin structure in the detector.

phase_2.failure_reason: Tri-ancestral reconnection over a transformed object — closes

phase_3.void_description: Unexcited QCD vacuum — no quark flavor, color, or spin degrees of freedom instantiated; the pre-perturbative ground state.
phase_3.true_description: Down quark successfully confined in a color-singlet hadron (proton or neutron) — asymptotic freedom satisfied, hadron mass generated, all quantum numbers conserved.
phase_3.false_description: Hypothetical free down quark state — color flux tube stretched to infinity, string tension unbroken, asymptotic freedom violated; not realized in the physical spectrum.
phase_3.both_description: The physical massive down quark as a chiral superposition — left-handed component (weak doublet) and right-handed component (weak singlet) held simultaneously in the Dirac spinor, a live contradiction resolved only by electroweak symmetry breaking and the Higgs mechanism.

steps.domain_action: Initialize the quark field vacuum — clear all flavor, color, and spin registers; establish the void state before any excitation.
Assert down quark identity — deposit immutable quantum numbers: generation=1, charge=-1/3, baryon_number=1/3, color=triplet.
Forward propagation — emit a gluon vertex, evolve the quark field in spacetime within the hadronic bag.
Chiral bifurcation — split the massless quark field into left-handed SU(2)_L doublet arm and right-handed SU(2)_R singlet arm.
On T-arm (left-handed) — deposit weak isospin I_3=-1/2, enable charged current weak interaction (W boson coupling).
On F-arm (right-handed) — deposit weak hypercharge Y=-2/3, enable only neutral current weak interaction (Z boson coupling).
At the chiral join — hold both chiralities simultaneously as the B-state; the massive quark is neither purely left nor purely right.
Hadron recombination — fuse chiral arms via Higgs Yukawa coupling and QCD condensate ⟨q̄q⟩, generating dynamical mass and reconstituting the Dirac fermion.
Hadron assembly — chain the confined quark with two up quarks (proton) or one up + one down (neutron) via sequential gluon exchanges.
⋈: Fidelity enforcement — SU(3) gauge symmetry enforces exact color-singlet condition at each vertex; deterministic coupling with near-certainty.
≺: Polarity resolution — signed color charge (triplet) matches with complementary anti-colors; electric charge -1/3 balances in hadron sum.
⊤: Kinetic barrier — confinement scale Λ_QCD creates high barrier; quark cannot escape without high-energy driving (deep inelastic scattering).
∈: Local interaction — gluon exchange at single vertex; correlation length ~1 fm, no propagation beyond hadronic boundary.
∋: Conjunctive partner selection — three quarks of specific complementary colors (RGB) must simultaneously combine for valid color singlet.
⊞: Stoichiometric ratio — asymmetric participation: proton (uud) has 1 down : 2 up; neutron (udd) has 2 down : 1 up.
⊡: Protection fixation — integer-winding topological invariants (baryon number, color winding) lock the role; cannot deform to trivial without gauge violation.
⊙: Criticality phase — subcritical; confined hadronic phase far from deconfinement/chiral restoration critical points.
⊥: Persistent chirality — multi-axis symmetry breaking: left doublet vs right singlet structurally enforced, not thermally interconvertible.
≻: Recognition mode — irreversible strong bond formation via gluon exchange; structural transformation creating permanent color-singlet confinement.
⊣: Terminal anchor — color-singlet boundary closes the system; hadron is the hermetic vessel containing the quark degrees of freedom.
Permanent record — deep inelastic scattering measurement fixes parton distribution function, momentum fraction, spin structure in detector.
Self-reference closure — the detected hadron carries the quark's identity forward; the stone that knows itself through its quantum numbers.

phase_5.compiler_frontend: QCD Lagrangian with SU(3)_c × SU(2)_L × U(1)_Y gauge symmetry — translates quark-gluon dynamics into vertex operations and confinement rules.
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: Gluon exchange — eight color-octet gauge bosons mediate strong interaction between quarks; color flux tubes communicate confinement forces.
phase_5.memory_mechanism: Quantum state in Hilbert space — color charge (3), flavor (down), spin (1/2), momentum fraction (x), and chiral components stored as entangled degrees of freedom.
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: Hamiltonian evolution — time-ordered Dyson series of gluon vertices; renormalization group flow sets scale-dependent coupling α_s(Q²).
phase_5.alfs_store: Standard Model / QCD — the canonical bootstrap store: Particle Data Group parameters, lattice QCD results, parton distribution functions, chiral perturbation theory.

phase_6.cycle_cost: One gluon vertex emission/absorption per interaction cycle — color charge exchange with no net entropy production in unitary evolution.
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: Quark in definite color, flavor, spin state within hadronic wavefunction; chiral components superposed.
phase_6.post_cycle_state: Quark in new color, momentum, spin state after gluon exchange; hadron wavefunction updated; chiral superposition preserved.
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — Fundamental QCD evolution is unitary and entropy-conservative; confinement is an entropic force only in effective string description, not at the microscopic gauge level.

grounding_reasoning:
⊣=𐑰: The down quark is permanently confined within hadrons (protons and neutrons), forming a nested hierarchy where quarks cannot exist as free particles outside their composite containers.
⊢=𐑼: The down quark is a point-like fundamental particle with no internal spatial structure, operating as a local degree of freedom within the quantum field.
⊞=𐑳: In protons (uud) and neutrons (udd), down quarks participate in asymmetric ratios (1:2 and 2:1 respectively) relative to up quarks, reflecting distinct compositional roles.
⊡=𐑭: The down quark carries conserved quantum numbers (baryon number 1/3, electric charge −1/3, color charge) that are integer-winding topological invariants, preventing continuous deformation to a trivial state without violating gauge symmetry.
⊙=𐑢: The down quark operates in the stable, confined hadronic phase far from the deconfinement or chiral symmetry restoration critical points, exhibiting no scale-free correlations in its bound state.
⊥=𐑖: The down quark exhibits persistent chirality through its distinct left-handed (SU(2) doublet) and right-handed (SU(2) singlet) components with structurally different gauge interactions, enforcing a multi-axis symmetry breaking that cannot be thermally interconverted.
≻=𐑑: The down quark participates in irreversible strong-interaction bond formation to create color-singlet hadrons, a structural transformation mediated by gluon exchange that permanently confines quarks into composite particles.
≺=𐑿: The down quark carries a signed color charge (triplet) and electric charge (−1/3), creating a directional interface where it acts as a donor of color flux that must be accepted by complementary anti-color charges to form neutral hadrons.
⋈=𐑐: The down quark's strong interaction vertices are governed by exact SU(3) gauge symmetry and color confinement, enforcing deterministic, geometry-constrained coupling with near-certainty at the fundamental level.
⊤=𐑧: The down quark is permanently confined within hadrons by the strong force, creating an extremely high kinetic barrier that prevents free propagation or rearrangement without external high-energy driving (e.g., deep inelastic scattering).
∈=𐑲: The down quark's strong interaction is strictly local, mediated by gluon exchange at a single vertex with no propagation of correlation beyond the immediate hadronic bound state (~1 fm).
∋=𐑝: The down quark must simultaneously combine with two other quarks of specific complementary color charges to form a color-singlet hadron, requiring all partners present at once for a valid bound state.
